main_text.l: hæc præoccupato Iudicio, & contradici non
ferente pronuncio. Satis constat, me conatum
fedulò, ut mihi integrè fieret exploratum,
quid diverfæ Partis Patroni præcipui vel contra
hanc obiicere, vel pro fua allegare potuissent:
id verò ferio tandem deprehendi, non Scriptu-
ra folum & ratione multum infra noftros cau-
fâ [?] cadere, fed exemplis Ecclefiarum, & Praxis,
& Historiarum Testimoniis plane deftitui, ita
toto flumine in Epifcopatum ruente, ut nec
tenuiffimus illis rivulus relinquatur.

ngantur, quàm ad Antiquarum [?] Ecclefiarum

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Antiquarum" (the word after "ad" is hard to make out, marked [?]); "cau-fâ" (the second part of the word split at the line end is uncertain, marked [?]). Long s normalised to plain s, including the ligature in "conftat" and "Chriftiano". Greek running head copied as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. Italic runs are read from the scan and may be slightly off. No printing errors were corrected.
